deadline.value: Fall applications must be received by January 1; applications after March 15 are generally not considered for fall.
deadline.quote: For admissions for the fall semester (starting in August), the deadline for us to receive completed applications is January 1 of the same year | Generally, applications received after March 15 are not considered for fall admission

gre_general.value: GRE general scores are not currently required for applicants.
gre_general.quote: GRE general scores are not currently required for applicants

gre_subject.value: The GRE Physics test is not required, but the department encourages sending a score if you have one.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Physics score is not required, but may be helpful for some applicants, and so we encourage you to send us your score

toefl_min.value: The department requires a TOEFL iBT of 100 for admission, higher than the Graduate School's 79.
toefl_min.quote: We require a minimum TOEFL score of 100 on the iBt scale (600 old scale) (IELTS 7.0) for admission

ielts_min.value: The department requires IELTS 7.0 for admission, higher than the Graduate School's 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: We require a minimum TOEFL score of 100 on the iBt scale (600 old scale) (IELTS 7.0) for admission

fee_waiver.value: The department has limited funds to cover the application fee for international applicants with demonstrable need; write to the admissions chair to ask.
fee_waiver.quote: We have limited funds to cover the application fee for international students with demonstrable need

supervisor.value: Contacting professors is suggested but not required; a major professor is chosen by mutual consent after the qualifying exam.
supervisor.quote: it might be useful to have direct contact with our professors

also.quote: who will be chosen by mutual consent, not assigned by the department

funding.value: Essentially all admitted students are offered a graduate assistantship (TA or RA), with a full tuition waiver and most health insurance.
funding.quote: essentially all students accepted into our Department are offered financial support in the form of a graduate assistantship

entry_route.value: Applicants who go straight from a four-year undergraduate programme are considered alongside others; no master's is mentioned as a prerequisite.
entry_route.quote: we have no bias against non-traditional students (i.e., those not applying directly out of a four-year undergraduate program)

notes: Astronomy is covered by the PhD in Physics (Appendix A: 'A Guide to Graduate Studies in Astronomy and Astrophysics (Leading to the PhD in Physics)', graduate-guide.php). The department's deadline-and-fee table (Jan 1 first round, May 15 final, Foreign $70) is split across lines, so it is not quoted. Medical physics track (separate application page) not covered. Department GRE and TOEFL wording dates partly from COVID-era notes on the FAQ.
